name: Discern Gods Will
overview: Scripture reveals that discerning God's will involves a deep reverence for Him, as He shares His covenant and guidance with those who fear Him (Psalms 25:14). Believers are called to trust wholeheartedly in the LORD rather than relying on their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5), for He orders the steps of the righteous and delights in their way (Psalms 37:23). God's direction is personal and clear, often described as a guiding word leading His people to walk in His path (Isaiah 30:21), and He makes a way even through impossible circumstances (Isaiah 43:16). Ultimately, knowing God's will is expressed in living justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Him (Micah 6:8).
